description: This file contains a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw aggregate records related to cost data, grouping and shaping the data into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It generates a dataset with zero-filled categories across agents to ensure consistent bar groups in charts.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a grouped dataset categorized by agent and optionally by environment or cost category, filling missing categories with zeros for consistent charting.
